title: Antiperistaltic
summary: ANTIPERISTAL'TIC, adjective [See Peristaltic.] Opposed to peristaltic; retroverted, as in vomiting; as, the antiperistaltic motion of the intestines.

inlines.v: ANTIPERISTAL'TIC, adjective [See Peristaltic.] Opposed to peristaltic; retroverted, as in vomiting; as, the antiperistaltic motion of the intestines.
